packageRules.description: whisperfish/presage crates share one git revision. Bumping only one duplicates presage and libsignal-service in Cargo.lock. For a rev-pinned Cargo git dependency the packageName is the git URL; the crate name is the depName.

whatsapp-rust sqlite-storage needs diesel ^2.3.14 and sqlite-wasm-rs 0.6. diesel 2.3.13 accepts only sqlite-wasm-rs <0.6, and both sqlite-wasm-rs versions set links = "wsqlite3", so Cargo refuses a lock that keeps both. diesel 2.3.14 still accepts the older sqlite-wasm-rs, so the lock keeps it unless sqlite-wasm-rs is updated in the same change. Group diesel and sqlite-wasm-rs with the whatsapp-rust updates.
libsqlite3-sys must match presage-store-sqlite and whatsapp-rust. Only one version can link.
notify-rust 4.18.2, zbus-secret-service-keyring-store 1.0.1, and secret-service 5.2.0 require zbus ^5. crates/thinwire-notify must use the same zbus major as the keychain.
